CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Tuesday, May 30, 2023
CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  Special Meeting, 6:00 PM

Victor Farfan, Mayor Pro Tem
Dandy De Paula, Council Member  Ernesto Marquez,City Manager
Luis Roa, Council Member  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney
Ernie Vargas, Council Member  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk
  Maria Teresa Del
  Rio, Mayor

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The City Council Special Meeting was called to order on Tuesday, May 30, 2023 at 6:01 PM.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT
  Mayor Del Rio
  Mayor Pro Tem Farfan
  Councilmember Roa
  Councilmember De Paula
  Councilmember Vargas
ABSENT
  None

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, announced a quorum.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ­ GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

There were no Public Comments.

DISCUSSION ITEM(S)
1.  Recommendation to review and discuss the proposed Citywide Budget for FY 2023­2024 and
  2024­2025.

  An overview of the City Finances ­ General Fund Revenues/Expenditures was given by Linda
  Hollinsworth, Finance Director.

  New Positions and Programs were discussed by department: Administration/City Clerk/Human
  Resources, Community Development, Finance, and Public Safety.

  Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, went over a list of Major Equipment Purchases, and a
  list of Capital Projects for the next two fiscal years.

  Next Steps – staff will prepare a PowerPoint Presentation for the June 13, 2023 City Council
  Meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 9:01 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
on Tuesday, June 13, 2023 at 6:00 PM.
